start: Demo gym as the owner; menu > Training progress

steps.action: Open Training progress
user_sees: Page title "Training progress"
Nine members, each with a trainer name and a weekly summary
One member marked as asking for help
"Members can switch sharing off in their app at any time. Body weight, photos and notes are never shared."
must_not: "Training progress is not ready for your gym yet"
"No members to show yet"
A member with no trainer name

steps.action: Tap a member to see their progress
user_sees: Workouts per week, strength per main exercise, the recent shared workouts
must_not: Body weight, photos or notes
An empty progress card
"NaN" in a figure

start: Demo gym as the owner; Settings > Staff & sign-in (trainer setup, make a trainer)

steps.action: Tick "Trainer" on the manager
user_sees: The tick stays on; the pill on the row changes to Trainer
must_not: "Only the owner can change this."
The demo locked words
The tick springs back

steps.action: Untick "Trainer" on the same person
user_sees: The tick is off again
must_not: The two seeded trainers lose their tick

start: Demo gym as the owner; a member page of a member with the app (assign a member)

steps.action: On the card "Trainer", pick another trainer in the box "Trainer"
user_sees: The new trainer stays picked
"The trainer sees this member's workout progress in Training progress, if the member shares it from the app."
must_not: An error
The pick lost on leaving and coming back in the same visit

steps.action: Open Training progress
user_sees: That member now shows the new trainer name
must_not: The old trainer name still shown

steps.action: On the member page look at the card "Progress"
user_sees: The shared progress for a member who shares; nothing for one who does not
must_not: Progress shown for a member who never shared

start: Demo gym at /demo?as=desk (front desk, not a trainer)

steps.action: Open Training progress from the menu or by address
user_sees: "Only trainers and the owner see this"
"Ask the owner to tick you as a trainer in Staff & sign-in."
must_not: The nine members and their workouts
A raw "TRAINER_ONLY" word

steps.action: Open a member page
user_sees: No "Progress" card and no "Trainer" picker
must_not: The member's shared workouts shown to the desk

start: Demo gym as the owner; a member with a trainer assigned

steps.action: On the member page set "Trainer" to none
user_sees: The member has no trainer
must_not: An error
Another member loses their trainer

steps.action: Set the trainer back
user_sees: The trainer name returns on the member page and in Training progress
must_not: Two trainers for one member

steps.action: Refresh the page
user_sees: The seeded trainers and assignments are back as at the start
must_not: The change kept after the refresh

start: Demo gym as the owner; Training progress open

steps.action: Read what is shown for each member
user_sees: Workout counts, strength scores and shared workouts only
"Body weight, photos and notes are never shared."
must_not: A body weight, a photo or a private note on any member
A real member
